_comment: Part 2 exposed as an MCP server over stdio. Point the OpenClaw gateway
(or any MCP client) at this. It reads the monitoring database read-only —
it does not poll, and it cannot execute anything on the network.
_note_on_credentials: The gateway side needs no controller credentials at all — only the path
to the SQLite file. That is the point of the split: a compromised or
malfunctioning model cannot reach the network, only the record of it.
